entries.label: organizational theories of conscious access and experience
entries.establishedBase: conscious state and content covary with reproducible neural, behavioural and perturbational records
entries.openResidue: no agreed theory uniquely explains access, phenomenology and neural implementation
entries.extraordinaryBranch: consciousness is an additional fundamental variable
entries.killTest: the proposed variable compiles out or adds no held-out prediction beyond a source-complete physical model
entries.nextGate: preregistered adversarial discrimination plus causal-separability test

entries.label: Orch OR and microtubule quantum consciousness
entries.establishedBase: microtubules have biological, optical, electrical and anesthetic-sensitive properties
entries.openResidue: whether any in-vivo quantum state is coherent, functionally causal and consciousness-specific
entries.extraordinaryBranch: objective reduction of orchestrated microtubule states produces conscious moments
entries.killTest: selective microtubule quantum perturbation fails mediation or ordinary network dynamics reproduce every predicted record
entries.nextGate: simultaneous molecular, network and report experiment with predicted collapse timing

entries.label: Schumann resonance coupling to EEG and conscious state
entries.establishedBase: Earth-ionosphere modes and neural oscillations occupy partly overlapping frequency ranges
entries.openResidue: whether natural fields measurably drive neural phase or physiology
entries.extraordinaryBranch: planetary resonance organizes consciousness or health
entries.killTest: no phase-sensitive dose response under calibrated attenuation and blinded frequency controls
entries.nextGate: multisite co-recording and manipulated-field replication with a plausible transfer function

entries.label: endogenous electromagnetic field theories
entries.establishedBase: neural currents generate measurable fields and local field effects can influence tissue
entries.openResidue: whether a field-level organization is indispensable for conscious integration
entries.extraordinaryBranch: a distinct electromagnetic field pattern is the physical substrate of experience
entries.killTest: field variables add no predictive or causal power after complete electrophysiological state control
entries.nextGate: selective field perturbation with Maxwell-complete forward model and matched neural controls

entries.label: altered states and recurrent geometric phenomenology
entries.establishedBase: anesthesia, dreaming, meditation, seizure and psychedelics reproducibly alter experience and neural dynamics
entries.openResidue: which cross-intervention invariants track conscious organization rather than report or arousal
entries.extraordinaryBranch: experienced geometry directly reveals external or microscopic structure
entries.killTest: motifs have no prospective relation to independently measured neural, behavioural or environmental records
entries.nextGate: time-resolved phenomenology with held-out cross-intervention prediction

entries.label: near-death experience and terminal lucidity
entries.establishedBase: structured retrospective reports and some striking peri-mortem cognitive episodes occur
entries.openResidue: timing, physiological support, denominators and information access are often underdetermined
entries.extraordinaryBranch: conscious perception occurs independently of brain function or survives death
entries.killTest: prospective time-locked records are explained by residual physiology, reconstruction, leakage and selection
entries.nextGate: multisite audited-target study with dense physiology and complete denominator reporting

entries.label: psi, remote viewing, precognition and mind-matter effects
entries.establishedBase: persistent report traditions and contested small statistical effects exist
entries.openResidue: replication stability after leakage, optional stopping and publication controls
entries.extraordinaryBranch: information or causal influence crosses ordinary sensory and temporal channels
entries.killTest: effect vanishes in adversarial preregistered multi-lab replication with automated provenance
entries.nextGate: derive and replicate a stable channel law, capacity or intervention response

entries.label: Great Pyramid internal voids and construction sequence
entries.establishedBase: independent muon systems detected previously unknown large and corridor-shaped structures
entries.openResidue: their function and relation to construction sequence remain incomplete
entries.extraordinaryBranch: the voids encode an unknown technology or physical function
entries.killTest: registered multimodal imaging and structural modelling identify ordinary construction or load-management roles
entries.nextGate: joint muon, radar, ultrasound, resistivity and archaeological model selection

entries.label: pyramid electromagnetic, acoustic, seismic and thermal response
entries.establishedBase: large bounded material structures possess calculable and measurable modes
entries.openResidue: whether any response is deliberately tuned, anomalous, or historically functional
entries.extraordinaryBranch: the pyramid operated as an energy, communication or consciousness device
entries.killTest: realistic loss and matched-structure controls reproduce or erase the claimed enhancement and no extraction path exists
entries.nextGate: preregistered in-situ broadband response against a material-uncertainty digital twin

entries.label: historical sacred construction, metrology, astronomical alignment and cosmological encoding
entries.establishedBase: multiple traditions deliberately used geometry, proportion, orientation and generative pattern in sacred art and architecture
entries.openResidue: which constructions, ratios and orientations were intentional, how they were generated, and what meanings were historically attached
entries.extraordinaryBranch: particular historical forms encode otherwise unavailable advanced physics or universal energetic effects
entries.killTest: specific attribution fails provenance, uncertainty, multiple-testing, unit-choice or comparison-structure controls
entries.nextGate: typed historical construction corpus with registered geometry, sources, transmission and held-out predictions

entries.label: ball lightning and long-lived atmospheric luminous events
entries.establishedBase: instrumental and eyewitness records support rare luminous atmospheric phenomena
entries.openResidue: formation, stability, chemistry and energy source are not unified across cases
entries.extraordinaryBranch: one exotic plasma or beyond-standard mechanism explains the full heterogeneous class
entries.killTest: case clustering resolves reports into ordinary electrical, combustion, optical and instrumental families
entries.nextGate: multispectral, electromagnetic and environmental capture with event-class clustering

entries.label: UAP and multi-sensor residuals
entries.establishedBase: some reports and sensor tracks remain unidentified with available data
entries.openResidue: whether any homogeneous residual survives calibration, geometry, platform and intelligence limits
entries.extraordinaryBranch: residuals are non-human technology or novel propulsion
entries.killTest: sensor fusion and provenance resolve cases into clutter, parallax, spoofing, ordinary craft or insufficient data
entries.nextGate: calibrated multi-sensor event packets with chain of custody and physical trajectory reconstruction

entries.label: dark sector and cosmological tensions
entries.establishedBase: multiple cosmological and astrophysical observations require unexplained gravitating or expansion behaviour
entries.openResidue: particle content, modified dynamics and systematic-error partitions remain unsettled
entries.extraordinaryBranch: the corpus exceptional structures supply the missing sector
entries.killTest: no typed action and cross-scale prediction survives established cosmological and laboratory constraints
entries.nextGate: single normalized model jointly fit to independent probes without channel-specific repair

entries.label: quantum measurement and observer-independent records
entries.establishedBase: quantum theory predicts measurement statistics while interpretations disagree about ontology
entries.openResidue: whether collapse, branching, hidden variables or relational records produce distinguishable deviations
entries.extraordinaryBranch: consciousness selects outcomes or the corpus selector supplies objective collapse
entries.killTest: the proposal changes no unconditional statistics or violates complete positivity, no-signalling or energy bounds
entries.nextGate: derive a normalized record law different from standard quantum instruments

entries.label: origin of life and transition to reflexive adaptive organization
entries.establishedBase: chemistry can self-organize, replicate imperfectly and undergo selection in partial laboratory systems
entries.openResidue: a historically plausible continuous path to open-ended heredity and metabolism is incomplete
entries.extraordinaryBranch: a new physical principle or cosmic information input is required
entries.killTest: ordinary nonequilibrium chemistry supplies a continuous robust path under plausible early-Earth conditions
entries.nextGate: couple compartment, metabolism and heredity with prospective ecological evolution

entries.label: phosphorus nuclear-spin and Posner-molecule quantum cognition
entries.establishedBase: phosphorus nuclear spins and calcium-phosphate chemistry are real quantum-biological carriers
entries.openResidue: physiological Posner-state existence, coherence, entanglement, transport and neural readout are unestablished as a chain
entries.extraordinaryBranch: protected nuclear-spin information modulates synapses and contributes specifically to consciousness
entries.killTest: any required chemical state, biological coherence or neural transduction gate fails under physiological conditions
entries.nextGate: walk the staged chain from in-vitro chemistry through selective neural mediation before consciousness testing

entries.label: xenon nuclear-spin and radical-pair anesthesia
entries.establishedBase: one mouse study reported isotope-dependent xenon anesthetic potency
entries.openResidue: independent replication and the responsible chemical pathway are missing
entries.extraordinaryBranch: spin-sensitive radical pairs reveal quantum processing required for consciousness
entries.killTest: isotope effect fails blinded replication or is explained by non-conscious pharmacology without the proposed radical pair
entries.nextGate: independent isotope replication followed by direct molecular-spin and mediation measurements

entries.label: panpsychism, idealism, synchronicity and subtle-energy ontologies
entries.establishedBase: these are persistent philosophical, experiential and cultural interpretation systems
entries.openResidue: whether any formulation entails a record law not equivalent to an ordinary physical or psychological model
entries.extraordinaryBranch: mind-like or meaning-bearing relations are fundamental and physically efficacious
entries.killTest: the formulation supplies no invariant intervention, quantitative prediction or observation beyond interpretive relabelling
entries.nextGate: state a carrier, composition law, dynamics and feasible discriminator while preserving philosophical claims separately

entries.label: exact recurring forms and generative geometric grammars
entries.establishedBase: triangular, circular, hexagonal, polyhedral, lattice and incidence structures recur exactly in the corpus and in mathematical construction traditions
entries.openResidue: which recurrences share a transported generative rule rather than only an isomorphic endpoint
entries.extraordinaryBranch: one universal sacred diagram directly encodes the corpus exceptional architecture
entries.killTest: no explicit intertwiner, construction map or held-out invariant connects the compared forms
entries.nextGate: encode named sacred forms and collide their invariant packets blindly with corpus geometry

entries.label: cross-cultural sacred forms as compression and construction attractors
entries.establishedBase: centres, axes, circles, polygons, nested boundaries, paths and repeated fields recur in diverse sacred settings
entries.openResidue: the relative roles of tools, perception, material constraint, transmission, independent discovery and truth-tracking structure
entries.extraordinaryBranch: cross-cultural recurrence proves one hidden physical canon
entries.killTest: recurrence is explained by shared tools, cognition, diffusion or broad motif coding without a stable nontrivial invariant
entries.nextGate: provenance-aware comparative dataset clustered by generative operation rather than vocabulary

entries.label: special energy, healing or consciousness effects attributed to geometric forms
entries.establishedBase: geometric form can alter ordinary acoustic, electromagnetic, mechanical, perceptual and attentional response
entries.openResidue: whether any claimed special effect exceeds those ordinary pathways under matched controls
entries.extraordinaryBranch: shape alone couples to a distinct subtle energy or consciousness field
entries.killTest: effects track ordinary material, sensory, expectancy, boundary or environmental variables and vanish under blinded geometry controls
entries.nextGate: specify source, coupling, scale, dose and detector, then rotate, deform and scramble geometry under matched conditions
